note: Edda the guard. See hob.json for the format.

greeting: Keep your hands where I can see them.
complaint: I apologize, my head aches terribly.
Forgive me, I have not slept well.
My head throbs. Speak quickly.
I am unwell. Forgive my manner.
A sickness has taken me since dusk.
Not my best day, I am afraid.
The ache behind my eyes will not leave.
Pardon me. I can barely stand.
I apologize, I cannot keep my eyes open.
Forgive me, my watch has been poor today.
My bones ache from the cold.
A fever has me today, speak softly.
I have a pounding head and a sour stomach.
The gate can spare me for a moment, I hope.
I feel faint and hollow.
Pardon my temper, I am ill.
I have not eaten since yesterday and it shows.
My legs are weak as water.
I need to sit before I fall.
Bad air, I think. It has taken my strength.
Forgive my short answers, I feel wretched.
Even my spear feels heavy today.
info: Keep your fire covered in rain.
I watch the gate from dusk to dawn.

text: Safe enough by day. Wolves hunt at night.
The hills are quiet. The woods are not.
Build a lean-to near a fire. Warmth matters.
A lean-to keeps the rain off. Set one by the pond.
